item.title: Will Apple’s upcoming low-cost MacBook actually be worthwhile?
item.description: As soon as next week, Apple is set to unveil its cheapest MacBook to date. It’ll be powered by an A18 Pro chip, offer a 12.9-inch display, and come in a plethora of colors.
